title: dryopteris × deweveri
intro: Dryopteris × deweveri, commonly known as Dewever's Wood Fern, is a hybrid fern species. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory properties and antioxidant activities, which may help protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Dewever's Wood Fern include its ability to soothe digestive issues and reduce stress, attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids. However, further research is needed to confirm the exact bioactive constituents and their therapeutic actions, and it should be used under the guidance of a healthcare professional.
